name: search-and-inspect
title: Search Fab and inspect a listing
summary: Search with a query and filters, pick a result, read its detail and engine versions

steps.why: Search Unreal Engine listings; add more --filter KEY=VALUE as the user asks (fabcli guide search)
steps.check: results[] has uid, title, seller, rating, is_free; show them and let the user pick one; cursors.next pages on with --cursor

steps.why: Full detail: description, seller, ratings, tags, pricing
steps.check: title, description, is_free; aiGenerated / aiTrainingForbidden when Fab reports them

steps.why: Which engine versions and platforms the asset supports

on_error.not_found: The listing has no Unreal Engine format

steps.why: Price, discount, and whether it is a Limited Time Free promo

notes: Save the uid the user picked, not always results.0.uid.
Unknown filter keys return no results rather than an error: check the spelling (styles, not style).
